title: Cerebus #119 Jaka's Story Part 6, Feb 1989 - Aardvark-Vanaheim
descriptionText:
This is a rare and collectible issue of Cerebus, featuring Jaka's story from February 1989. The comic was created by Dave Sim and published by Aardvark-Vanaheim. It belongs to the US Comics tradition and falls under the genre of comics and graphic novels. The issue number is 6 and it is part of the Cerebus series title.

This comic book is a must-have for fans and collectors of Cerebus and US Comics. The story features the character Jaka and is sure to captivate readers with its unique art style and storytelling. Don't miss the opportunity to add this rare piece to your collection.
